label: Etsy Shop Scraper
title: Etsy Shop Scraper: Shop Profiles & Full Catalogs
metaDescription: Scrape any Etsy shop by URL, name or ID: profile, policies, about story, ratings and its complete listing catalog with prices, shipping and stock.
intro: Give it an Etsy shop URL, name or ID and get the shop's profile (policies, about story, FAQ, ratings, trust signals) and, if you want it, its complete listing catalog with prices, images, shipping and stock. Public data, no login.
useCases: Benchmark competitor shops on catalog size, prices and ratings
Build a lead list of Etsy sellers in a niche
Track a shop's catalog changes and new products

faq.q: Can I see how many sales an Etsy shop has?
faq.a: Yes, when the shop shows it: the profile row includes the sold count Etsy displays. In the sample above, MarHappiness shows 49,088 sales.

faq.q: Can I get every listing in a shop?
faq.a: Yes. Switch listings on and set the maximum; the actor pages through the shop catalog and returns each listing with price, stock and variations.

officialApi: Etsy's Open API v3 is free, but you register an app, get an API key and work within its rate limits and endpoint shapes. These scrapers need no key: they return what the public Etsy pages show, ready to export. This one returns a whole shop (profile, ratings, sold count and catalog) from a shop URL or name.
